color: rgb(10, 20, 36) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Rate limiter 'ApiPerIpPolicy' is registered and UseRateLimiter runs,
but NO endpoint calls RequireRateLimiting and no GlobalLimiter is set
→ the limiter enforces nothing today

div.style: color: rgb(10, 20, 36) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
The same policy is not partitioned by IP despite its name —
if wired, it would be one 60/min window shared by all callers

div.style: color: rgb(10, 20, 36) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
POST /api/blobs/integrity accepts an arbitrary blobPath array
and mints read SAS URLs with no ownership check

div.style: color: rgb(10, 20, 36) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Client [Authorize] on pages is UI-only;
the server guard is what actually enforces access

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;
color: rgb(10, 20, 36) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ANONYMOUS BY DESIGN
/auth/me · /auth/config · /auth/login/* · POST /auth/logout
MapStaticAssets (incl. /_framework) · MapFallbackToFile index.html

div.style: color: rgb(10, 20, 36) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ANONYMOUS — FLAGGED
GET /health · GET /diag · GET /diag/boot
diag returns masked endpoint/key, storage status, CPU, memory
diag/boot returns environment name and boot stage

div.style: color: rgb(10, 20, 36) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
color: rgb(10, 20, 36) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
color: rgb(10, 20, 36) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ROLE-GUARDED
NONE — roles are parsed, transported in AuthStateDto,
and never checked by any guard

span.p:
UseAuthentication — DefaultScheme = Cookie
DefaultChallengeScheme = OIDC when ClientId set, else Cookie

div.style: color: rgb(10, 20, 36) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(10, 20, 36) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(10, 20, 36) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(10, 20, 36) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
RequireAuthorization() → default policy
schemes = [Cookie] (+ FakeAuth only when DeveloperBypassAuth)

div.style: color: rgb(10, 20, 36) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(10, 20, 36) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
No metadata → fallback policy
schemes = [Cookie] ONLY — FakeAuth deliberately excluded
so an always-succeeds guest cannot auto-authenticate /auth/me

div.style: color: rgb(10, 20, 36) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(10, 20, 36) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Production: Microsoft only
MicrosoftEnabled = AzureAd:ClientId configured
GuestEnabled = false (hard-forced by !IsProduction)

div.style: color: rgb(10, 20, 36) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
GET /auth/login/microsoft → OIDC code + PKCE
authority {Instance}/{TenantId}/v2.0 · scopes openid profile email
IssuerValidator checks AzureAd:AllowedTenants

Test: Guest bypass
FakeAuth scheme via X-Fake-User / X-Fake-Roles headers

Cookie 'PoWatch.Auth'
HttpOnly · SameSite=Strict · Secure=Always
24h sliding · DataProtection keyring (blob or filesystem)
